_comment_AzureAdCiamMaui: Public-client (native) app registration in the same Entra External ID (CIAM) tenant as AzureAdCiam (Server) / AzureAdCiam (Web) — a mobile/desktop app cannot use either of those (they're a confidential Web API client and a SPA client respectively). ClientId must also be registered as the app's redirect URI in Azure: on Android as 'msal{ClientId}://auth' (see Platforms/Android/AndroidManifest.xml, which must be updated with the same ClientId), on iOS/MacCatalyst as 'msauth.com.geoassets.app://auth' (matches ApplicationId above, already wired into Platforms/iOS and Platforms/MacCatalyst's Info.plist).

GeoAssetsServer._comment: BaseUrl is required (Identity authorization + Service Order workflow, XD01-24) — the gateway (GeoAssets.Gateway, XD01-384) that fronts GeoAssets.Server and the vertical hosts; the local dev default below is the gateway run locally (dotnet run, port 5070). ApiScope is optional; leave blank to sign in with only the default OIDC scopes.

ServiceOrders._comment: The kernel's workflow API on the gateway (XD01-384); order types a vertical runs in its own host are reached at the route their descriptor names on the same origin.

FieldServiceServer._comment: BaseUrl for the mobile offline-sync endpoints (XD01-243/XD01-208) — local dev default below points at GeoAssets.FieldService.Server run locally.
